titel: Ep. 385 - MFN deals, Lilly takeout, FDA pick Overton

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Pharma deals, Eli Lilly's latest acquisition, and regulatory updates at the FDA.
kurzfassung: Seventeen pharmaceutical companies have signed most favored nation drug pricing deals with the White House, while Eli Lilly acquired Merida for up to $2.9 billion in cash. Meanwhile, Heidi Overton was nominated as the next FDA commissioner, and Revolution Medicines received rapid approval for its pancreatic cancer therapy.
stichpunkte: Seventeen pharma companies have joined the White House MFN drug pricing initiative.
International companies dominate the current MFN deal participant list over US firms.
Eli Lilly acquired Merida for nearly $2.9 billion in cash to boost its immunology pipeline.
Merida brings preclinical and clinical assets targeting autoimmune and allergic diseases.
Heidi Overton was nominated by Donald Trump to succeed Marty Makary as FDA commissioner.
Overton's nomination faces a tight Senate confirmation window and potential political hurdles.
Revolution Medicines gained rapid FDA approval for its first-in-class pancreatic cancer drug via the CNPV program.

clips.hook: Foreign companies dominate the MFN deal list
clips.text: The participating companies in the MFN agreements are primarily headquartered outside of the United States because part of the arrangement exempts them from upcoming Section 232 tariffs.

clips.hook: Eli Lilly's massive acquisition spending in 2025
clips.text: Eli Lilly has completed thirteen acquisitions this year, deploying over thirty-one billion dollars in total deal value and at least twenty-two billion in upfront payments alone.

clips.hook: Surge in European attendance at the Shanghai summit
clips.text: Record numbers of European attendees and venture capitalists are traveling to the upcoming Shanghai conference, with many making the trip for the first time.
The nominee holds an MD and a PhD in clinical investigation, is board-certified in preventive medicine, and completed general surgery training at Johns Hopkins.

clips.hook: Record-breaking review speed for a cancer drug
clips.text: Revolution Medicines achieved clearance from the agency in just thirty-five days from filing and forty days from initial submission.

beschreibung:
Mid-sized biopharma companies are under growing pressure to accept most-favored nation drug pricing deals with the White House. On the latest BioCentury This Week podcast, BioCentury's analysts assess the trade-offs companies face, the litigation risks around mandatory Medicare MFN pricing demonstrations, and what happens to companies that don't sign on.
The analysts also discuss Eli Lilly's acquisition of Merida, its thirteenth takeout of the year, Heidi Overton's nomination as FDA commissioner and what it signals about FDA independence, and Revolution Medicines' 35-day filing-to-approval timeline under FDA's national priority review voucher pilot.
